summary.oneLiner: Solid transactions page with good design system adherence; minor spacing inconsistencies and accessibility gaps.

findings.title: Search input missing visible label
findings.impact: Screen reader users may not understand the purpose of the input field; relies solely on placeholder text.

fix.summary: Add a visually hidden label for screen readers.

findings.title: Limited micro-interactions beyond basic transitions
findings.impact: Page feels functional but lacks memorable touches that reinforce the friendly guide persona.

fix.summary: Add subtle hover animations on transaction items or filter badges.

findings.title: Non-standard padding values
findings.impact: Breaks the 4px spacing rhythm defined in the design system, creating subtle visual inconsistencies.

fix.summary: Align padding to design system spacing tokens (p-6, p-4, py-2, py-3).
